description: Update a runtime budget gate (Pro+ only). Partially updates any of monthlyLimitUsd / enforceMode / enabled. Example phrasing: "raise the limit to $100" / "disable the gate temporarily" / "switch to fail_closed"

enforceMode.description: Behavior when the backend is unreachable

gateId.description: Target gate id (from get_budget_gate, starts with bg_)

monthlyLimitUsd.description: New monthly limit in USD (0.01 - 1000000, $0.01 increments)

name: update_budget_gate
